units.title: How long does it take…?
units.rule: Biror ish qancha vaqt olishini soʻrash uchun *How long does it take to + feʼl?* deymiz: *How long does it take to get to school?* — Maktabga borish qancha vaqt oladi? Javob: *It takes + vaqt*: *It takes ten minutes.* — Oʻn daqiqa oladi. Kimga ekanini aytsak, *me, him, her* qoʻshamiz: *It takes me an hour.* Oʻtgan zamonda *took*: *It took two hours.* Inkor: *It doesn't take long.* — Koʻp vaqt olmaydi.
examples: How long does it take to get to school?
It takes me an hour to cook dinner.
How long does it take to walk to the park?

text.title: How long does it take?
text.en:
Dilnoza: Aziz, how long does it take to get to Usmat from Samarkand?
Aziz: It takes two hours by bus.
Dilnoza: That's long! How do you come to school?
Aziz: On foot. It takes me fifteen minutes.
Dilnoza: It takes me five minutes. I live near the school.
Aziz: And Malika? She lives in Tashkent.
Dilnoza: It takes her four hours by car. She comes on Monday.
